verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents signed, real-time webhooks for domain/DNS events (registrations, renewals, transfers, expirations, DNS changes) with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification guide, and even supports testing webhook delivery in sandbox mode. This directly satisfies event-subscription-via-webhooks for AI-native automation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that webhook delivery works reliably in production, and no evidence of subscription management (choosing which events to receive) beyond the general description.
